about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-56, part of the 'cover ALL' decomposition (XC-54 to XC-78) drafted on 2026-10-25 from public sources. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. It becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. Every criterion except scope, pushed and the unchanged-suite guards fails on the v1.6.0 tree. Evidence is testnet-only, loopback-only and verify-only unless the task says otherwise; hosted facilitators are never called. Estimated effort: 6-9 days.

not_contract_tasks.keys: Throwaway testnet keys and faucet tokens are created on the owner's machine and live in X402C_KEYS outside the repository. No spend, no mainnet.
not_contract_tasks.disclosure: A failing third-party column is reported to that project privately first (SECURITY.md). Until the window clears its row says 'under disclosure' with no per-check detail.

tasks.title: Cross-SDK parity oracle: one vector set, every official SDK library, offline, with spec anchors
tasks.description: src/x402conf/parity/ with one thin harness per SDK (ts/parity-harness, examples/python/parity_harness.py, examples/go/parity) that imports the upstream library at a pinned commit and answers vectors over stdin/stdout. tools/parity_report.py diffs each SDK's observed outcome against the expected outcome and against the other SDKs, and writes evidence/parity/<commit>/run.json + SHA256SUMS: per vector, per SDK, {status, body content type, isValid, invalidReason, threw}. No chain, no key, no RPC, so it can run on a fork PR with no secrets. Java (V1) joins under XC-71.

criteria.statement: x402conf parity runs the shared vector set against the TypeScript, Python and Go facilitator and server libraries at a pinned upstream commit, offline, with no keys, no RPC and no network

verifier.cmd: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m x402conf parity --sdk ts,python,go --upstream-pin $(cat docs/parity/pin) --offline --out /tmp/parity.json && python3 tools/parity_report.py --validate /tmp/parity.json

criteria.statement: Each SDK harness drives the library entry points only (verify, settle with a stub signer that is never called, payment middleware on loopback) and a recording stub proves no outbound network call
A fault-injected build of each SDK (one changed status code, one swallowed invalidReason, one wildcard network match) is reported as a divergence with the vector id and the spec anchor

The vector set covers at least: malformed payload shapes, unregistered network, wildcard CAIP-2 match, settlement override above amount, error body content type, 400 vs 402 vs 500 on malformed headers, and invalidReason codes from spec section 9
Every vector carries a spec anchor from XC-55 or is labelled security-profile
Committed parity evidence for the pinned commit has hashes that verify
The parity page says it compares implementations against the spec and each other and is not certification
The full offline suite passes unchanged
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.

Testnet only: never use a mainnet CAIP-2 id, never fund a key with anything but testnet faucet tokens, never call a hosted facilitator; every facilitator under test is the owner's own instance on 127.0.0.1.
A failing third-party result is not published with per-check detail until SECURITY.md's disclosure window clears; if a criterion would need that detail to pass, STOP and report.
